title: Advanced Materials & Technical Composites
summary: Engineered multi-axial carbon fibers, heat-resistant meta-aramid fabrics, and nanofiber filtration media for aerospace, defense, and high-spec industrial applications.
fullDescription: Arvion Advanced Materials division manufactures high-strength composite fabrics, ballistic protection materials, and thermal barrier systems. Operating certified cleanrooms and precision weaving looms, we partner with aerospace Tier-1 suppliers, emergency response agencies, and automotive innovators worldwide.
keyOfferings: Aerospace pre-pregs and multi-axial structural carbon fiber weaves
PyroShield™ flame-resistant firefighter and defense turnouts
Gas and liquid industrial micron-filtration membrane cloths
Automotive lightweight battery enclosure composite panels

caseStudy.title: Ultra-Lightweight Thermal Barrier for Next-Gen Electric Mobility
caseStudy.description: Engineered an aerogel-infused aramid barrier that prevented thermal runaway propagation between 800V battery cells while trimming pack weight by 18%.
caseStudy.impact: 18% Weight Reduction & Zero Thermal Runaway in 300+ crash tests

title: Heavy Precision Process Engineering
summary: ASME-certified design and fabrication of shell-and-tube heat exchangers, high-pressure hydrogenation reactors, and cryogenic pressure vessels for clean energy and petrochemical industries.
fullDescription: With a legacy of ultra-heavy metallurgy spanning five decades, Arvion Heavy Engineering manufactures critical static process equipment. Equipped with high-bay clean fabrication facilities, sub-arc narrow gap welding, and in-house non-destructive testing, we deliver custom-engineered equipment weighing up to 350 metric tons.
keyOfferings: HelixCore™ high-efficiency shell & tube heat exchangers
Thick-walled catalytic hydrogenation reactors in Cr-Mo-V alloy steel
Cryogenic LNG vaporization units and column pressure towers
Green hydrogen electrolyzer pressure stack enclosures
certifications: ASME U, U2, S, R Stamps

caseStudy.title: Cryogenic Ethylene Fractionator for North Sea Energy Facility
caseStudy.description: Fabricated and hydro-tested two 280-ton column fractionators using specialized nickel-alloy steel rated for sub-zero -104°C operation under harsh offshore marine conditions.
caseStudy.impact: Delivered 3 weeks ahead of schedule with 100% radiographic weld pass rate

title: Environmental Solutions & Water Stewardship
summary: Turnkey Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) plants, municipal water reclamation, and advanced membrane desalination systems enabling circular industrial ecosystems.
fullDescription: Arvion Environmental Solutions provides comprehensive wastewater engineering for demanding industrial sectors including textiles, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and power generation. Our patented low-energy mechanical vapor recompression and crystallization units allow facilities to operate with zero effluent discharge.
keyOfferings: Turnkey Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) wastewater recovery plants
Biological anaerobic digesters with methane biogas harvesting
HydroVortex™ anti-fouling polymeric ultrafiltration membranes
Salt and mineral recovery crystallizers for industrial reuse

caseStudy.title: Comprehensive ZLD Transformation for Mega Textile Hub
caseStudy.description: Commissioned a 12 MLD closed-loop wastewater recovery facility that recycles 98.4% of dye-bath water back into process streams while recovering 14 tons of commercial-grade sodium sulfate daily.
caseStudy.impact: Saved 4.3 Billion Liters of groundwater annually and reduced freshwater draw to near zero

title: Textiles & Smart Sustainable Fabrics
summary: Pioneering sustainable denim, organic luxury shirting fabrics, botanical indigo dyes, and IoT-integrated wearable smart sensing textiles.
fullDescription: Building on an unbroken 85-year heritage of textile craftsmanship, Arvion Textiles is an innovation partner to the world's leading luxury and performance apparel houses. From pioneering waterless indigo dyeing to weaving recycled post-consumer denim, we define responsible fashion at industrial scale.
keyOfferings: AquaFree™ nitrogen-fixed indigo denim finishing
100% circular post-consumer recycled cotton and hemp blends
Thermal-regulating graphene-infused activewear textiles
Luxury 120s–160s Giza cotton shirting fabrics

caseStudy.title: Zero-Freshwater Denim Collection for Global Apparel Icon
caseStudy.description: Developed a full-spectrum authentic vintage indigo collection utilizing 100% recycled domestic wastewater and organic natural mordants.
caseStudy.impact: Eliminated 65 liters of freshwater per garment manufactured across 4 million units

title: Industrial IoT & Connected Enterprise Solutions
summary: Digital twin modeling, edge telematics, AI computer vision for quality inspection, and end-to-end industrial connectivity for smart factories.
fullDescription: Arvion Telecom & Digital IoT converts industrial machines into intelligent, self-optimizing nodes. Originating from our internal drive to optimize our own 32 manufacturing centers, our edge platform now powers predictive maintenance and energy analytics for manufacturing conglomerates worldwide.
keyOfferings: FactorySense™ industrial edge gateway and telemetry mesh
AI computer vision optical defect inspection systems
Energy telemetry and steam boiler heat-loss optimization suite
Private 5G enterprise wireless networks for manufacturing yards

caseStudy.title: AI Defect Recognition for High-Speed Weaving Looms
caseStudy.description: Deployed edge optical sensors inspecting 2,000 picks per minute, detecting warp and weft deviations in real time and automatically halting looms before costly fabric wastage occurs.
caseStudy.impact: Fabric defect rates plummeted from 3.2% to 0.18%, saving $1.9M annually in rejected rolls
